protocol.candidate: LR C1 seed7 + global/industry/region shifts, shrink500
protocol.calendar: all quarterly starts from earliest license year to snapshot
protocol.minimum_fit: n>=200, events>=20, non-events>=20 in both training and calibration
protocol.minimum_note: Computational screening only, not proof historical records are complete. Earlier periods retained in coverage, not silently discarded.
protocol.scope: Every eligible active permit at each landmark; no random subsampling.

limitations: Historical completeness unverified; unusually sparse early closures must not be interpreted as real low risk.
Quarterly outcomes overlap, repeated permits; not independent trials.
Early or poorly represented industries can use baseline fallback; no declaration of service eligibility.
Post-hoc expanded evaluation; no threshold tuning, no service update.
